items.title: The Cech complex of a family of morphisms is an exact functor on abelian presheaves
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that the Cech complex construction, for a fixed family of morphisms with a fixed target, is an exact functor on the category of abelian presheaves (statement lines 1503-1508). The proof is short but complete: it reduces exactness of sequences of abelian presheaves to exactness of the sequences of values at every object, using that this category is a functor category (proof lines 1521-1528), and then observes that each degree of the Cech complex is a product of those values, so the sequence of complexes is a product of short exact sequences in every degree (proof lines 1528-1529). The non-formal content is the identification of the Cech complex with products of values. The claim is H1: a short reduction plus a direct verification.
